Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome to Snooze + Camp Snooze! 🏕️

Your Snooze membership will start the Friday before camp begins. We need you to complete a couple of things before then.

 

Here's what to do first:

1. Download the Kajabi App for the Best Snooze Experience


Access all your Snooze resources on-the-go with the Kajabi app:

📱 Download for iOS

📱 Download for Android

Once downloaded, log in with your email and password to access all your Snooze content.

2. Complete Your Camp Snooze Intake Form IMPORTANT


Please complete your intake form as soon as possible. Sally and Bec use this information to create your personalised sleep plan for camp.

Complete Your Intake Form →

https://forms.gle/JxzVuV4LBdjRvkZf6

3. What Happens Next for Camp Snooze

  • A couple of days before camp: You'll receive your packing list and custom sleep schedule
  • Before camp starts: You'll get access to Snooze and the private Camp Snooze channel for your intake
  • When camp begins: Join the live calls and get dedicated support as you implement your plan
  • Each morning during camp: Daily roll call at 10-11am AEDT / UTC+11 (recordings available)

We'll send you all the details and camp plan closer to your camp start date.

Questions?
For the best support, email sally@joinsnooze.com and we can help answer any questions in the meantime. We're here to help.

See you in Snooze and at camp roll call on Day 1! 🏕️

Sally + Bec
The Sleep Concierge
